title: Quentin and the Protocol
author: Astrid Iversen
blurb: Sebastian Vane, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
